title: Why We Want What We Can't Have | Human Psychology #shorts
description:
Jo paas hai, woh aam kyun lagta hai? Aur jo nahi milta, wahi itna khaas kyun lagta hai? 👀

This is the psychology of desire: sometimes, we become more attracted to something simply because it is out of reach.

Kabhi-kabhi humein kisi cheez se zyada, usse paane ki excitement chahiye hoti hai. Aur jaise hi woh mil jaati hai, hamari nazar kisi aur cheez par chali jaati hai.

Agli baar khud se poochhna:

"Mujhe sach mein yeh chahiye, ya bas isliye chahiye kyunki mere paas nahi hai?"

📖 Inspired by Law 5: The Law of Covetousness from The Laws of Human Nature by Robert Greene.

💭 Understand your desires before letting them control you.
